steps.observed: Landing page rendered with guest shell and guest CTAs.

assertions.issues: Non-blocking hydration mismatch console error appeared on a later landing-page revisit during evidence capture.

summary: Tested 8 assigned assertions: 5 passed and 3 were blocked (authenticated-home redirect unavailable; discovery empty-state fixture unavailable). Evidence was captured for all exercised UI routes, and one non-blocking hydration mismatch console error was observed during the cross-flow landing-page revisit.
